2609.09989.title: Stable Answers, Unfinished Reasoning: Why Self-Consensus Is Not a Safe Early-Exit Signal
2609.09989.paper_summary: A natural way to cut reasoning-model inference cost is to repeatedly probe a single partial trajectory for its current answer and stop once probes agree -- self-consensus. We ask whether any such rule is both safe and token-saving, and whether one can be selected once and reused. A preregistered sweep of 3,520 consensus rules, replayed on frozen trajectories from two models and three benchmarks, clears none of three acceptance gates fixed in advance; the frontier reproduces on a held-out split and on two unseen models -- while a boundary-confidence control (DEER) swept through the same pipeline clears all three. The reason lies in the signal: agreement establishes that the current answer persists under a fixed probing procedure, not that the reasoning has terminated -- a consensus-termination gap. Stopping on it commits non-terminal answers. At a rule still saving 32% of the tokens, one stop in nine fires on an answer the trajectory itself later abandons, and most of those stops cut off a correction it would otherwise have made. Widening the agreement window does not remove them: the share levels off near 7%, and by then the saving has fallen to 8%. Probe re-wording and a hand-labelled error taxonomy show the agreed answer is often a placeholder the model had not settled on. Used on its own as the stop signal, agreement fails not because it is insufficiently strict, but because it repeatedly measures the wrong object.
2609.09989.paper_summary_zh: 自然地降低推理模型推斷成本的方法是反覆探測單一部分軌跡以獲得當前答案，並在探測結果一致時停止——自我共識。我們詢問是否有任何這樣的規則既安全又節省標記，並且是否可以選擇一次並重複使用。對3,520條共識規則的預註冊掃描，在來自兩個模型和三個基準的凍結軌跡上重播，未能通過事先固定的三個接受閘；邊界在保留的分割和兩個未見過的模型上重現——而邊界置信度控制（DEER）在相同流程中掃過則通過了所有三個。原因在於信號：一致性確立了當前答案在固定探測程序下的持續性，而不是推理已經終止——共識終止差距。在此情況下停止會使非終端答案被承諾。在一個仍然節省32%標記的規則中，每九次停止中就有一次觸發了軌跡本身後來放棄的答案，而這些停止大多數切斷了它本來會做出的修正。擴大一致性窗口並不會消除它們：比例在接近7%時趨於平穩，而到那時節省已降至8%。探測重新措辭和手動標記的錯誤分類顯示，達成一致的答案通常是模型尚未確定的佔位符。作為停止信號單獨使用時，一致性失敗的原因不是因為它不夠嚴格，而是因為它反覆測量了錯誤的對象。
